en: Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a crowded seaside beach with people walking and bathing along the shore. A wooden bathing pavilion or pier structure stands on stilts to the left, while foliage frames the foreground on the right. In the distance a headland stretches into the sea. Printed captions at the top provide the place name in French and Bulgarian/Cyrillic.
